#!/usr/bin/env python3

import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import unittest


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("local_doctest", ROOT / "doctest.py")
doctest = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(doctest)


class DoctestExceptionNotesRegressionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_doctest(self, source, globs=None):
        test = doctest.DocTestParser().get_doctest(
            source, globs or {}, "exception_notes", __file__, 0
        )
        output = []
        result = doctest.DocTestRunner().run(test, out=output.append)
        return result, "".join(output)

    def assert_doctest_passes(self, source, globs=None):
        result, output = self.run_doctest(source, globs)
        self.assertEqual(result.failed, 0, output)

    def assert_doctest_fails(self, source, globs=None):
        result, _ = self.run_doctest(source, globs)
        self.assertEqual(result.failed, 1)

    def test_ordinary_exception_note_is_compared(self):
        self.assert_doctest_passes(
            """
            >>> error = ValueError("bad value")
            >>> error.add_note("ordinary note")
            >>> raise error
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
            ValueError: bad value
            ordinary note
            """
        )
        self.assert_doctest_fails(
            """
            >>> error = ValueError("bad value")
            >>> error.add_note("actual note")
            >>> raise error
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
            ValueError: bad value
            incorrect note
            """
        )

    def test_multiple_notes_are_compared_in_order(self):
        self.assert_doctest_passes(
            """
            >>> error = RuntimeError("failure")
            >>> error.add_note("first note")
            >>> error.add_note("second note")
            >>> raise error
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
            RuntimeError: failure
            first note
            second note
            """
        )
        self.assert_doctest_fails(
            """
            >>> error = RuntimeError("failure")
            >>> error.add_note("first note")
            >>> error.add_note("second note")
            >>> raise error
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
            RuntimeError: failure
            second note
            first note
            """
        )

    def test_syntax_error_family_ignores_location_but_compares_notes(self):
        def raise_indentation_error():
            error = IndentationError(
                "bad indentation", ("decorated.py", 7, 3, "  broken\n")
            )
            error.add_note("syntax note")
            raise error

        globs = {"raise_indentation_error": raise_indentation_error}
        self.assert_doctest_passes(
            """
            >>> raise_indentation_error()
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
            IndentationError: bad indentation
            syntax note
            """,
            globs,
        )
        self.assert_doctest_fails(
            """
            >>> raise_indentation_error()
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
            IndentationError: bad indentation
            incorrect syntax note
            """,
            globs,
        )

    def test_exception_without_notes_keeps_existing_behavior(self):
        self.assert_doctest_passes(
            """
            >>> raise LookupError("missing")
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
            LookupError: missing
            """
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
